# Create a Battlefield In Your Own Home – and Play it with Your Friends!
Build maps and transform your space, **big or small**, into an action-packed arena, **using both your real furniture and virtual objects** for cover!

Then, invite your friends over and have a friendly battle in mixed reality. Or just invite our “friendly” bots and play your map single player for aim, glory and creative satisfaction.
‎{443185905216453}

‎

# Want to save the world from inter-dimensional invasions by yourself?
Progress through the **single player campaign** as you fight to save the world. Maybe, just maybe, you will clear it faster than your friends. According to the reviews, players love this game mode!

![{"height":417,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974539_1768595960549283_1769897805933639675_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Ol_wr37VDQMQ7kNvgH3fC-j&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBMAje-YPUgMz0Y6NGGpVTyVWVqED8H612_FB5XHKan4w&oe=674998CE)

‎

# Key Features:
- **Map builder** – Be creative! Turn your real world space into a playable battlefield arena. Hide behind **your sofa or a virtual crate**, sneak behind real corners.
- **Co-Located Multiplayer Games** – Meet up in the same real-world space (like your home) and play up to 8 players in fun, competitive and team-based modes.
- **Multiplayer Game Modes** – Engage in Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, and Domination.
- **Story-Driven Single Player Mode** – Experience the excitement of **portals opening up in your own home** as you fend off threats from other dimensions and uncover the dark secrets behind their invasion.
- **Weapons and Upgrades** – Unlock new weapons and upgrades, customize your loadout.

![{"height":206,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57575353_540056142209510_5771246485330685228_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_SsXQ7z776kQ7kNvgHhML77&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA42VKY0XpZ-yTXqFfWa5qnkTX2Wv7NJTPEeV5QA056mA&oe=6749B94C)

‎

# The world is under threat, and we need elite, creative, agents like you!
Embark on a **thrilling mixed reality adventure* to save the world! Transform your space virtually and **battle it out with friends or bots**.
